sample.question:
The robot R moves on adjacent tower tops. It may climb up by at most 1 level unless a ladder connects the two towers; it may descend freely. Starting from R, after the move sequence right, left, up, right, left, where does the robot end up?
Options:
[1] (1, 2)
[2] (4, 2)
[3] (1, 4)
[4] (2, 1)
[5] (2, 3)
[6] (2, 2)
[7] (1, 1)
[8] (1, 3)
sample.analysis:
Move 1 right: moved from (4, 2) to (4, 3) because ladder edge.
Move 2 left: moved from (4, 3) to (4, 2) because normal height rule.
Move 3 up: blocked from (4, 2) to (4, 2) because height jump from 1 to 3 is too high.
Move 4 right: moved from (4, 2) to (4, 3) because ladder edge.
Move 5 left: moved from (4, 3) to (4, 2) because normal height rule.
Final coordinate is (4, 2). Therefore choose option 2.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.
